description: A check on what enters or leaves a model call: limits, topic rules, PII redaction, classifiers. Useful noise reduction; not a substitute for architecture.
Checks before the model (on the user's input) and after it (on the answer). Cheapest rails first.
The check-digit algorithm of payment card numbers; validating it removes most false positives of a card pattern.
Brazil's individual taxpayer number, personal data under the LGPD, with two check digits computed modulo 11.
When a security check cannot decide (the classifier errored), block. The opposite, fail open, lets attackers win by breaking the check.
A model, often small and fine-tuned, that classifies inputs or outputs as safe or unsafe, such as the Llama Guard and Prompt Guard families.
The share of legitimate requests a rail blocks. Measure it with the same care as the catch rate.
